name: Wash day hair transformation routines
what_it_is: Videos show creators documenting multi-step "wash day" hair routines, usually filmed from behind in a bathroom, moving through stages labeled dirty, washed, detangled, dried and styled, often with a "Rare. Super Rare. Epic. Mythic. Legendary" sound effect. Others share long-hair care tips, product routines (OGX, Olaplex, horse-derived shampoo), and comedic takes on wash day.
